versionHistory.title: Version history
versionHistory.graphSubtitle: Tap a version to see what changed.

1_1_0.summary: Fixes and improvements to AI analysis, text input, photo editing, and error messages.

aiAnalysis.title: More reliable AI analysis
aiAnalysis.description: Improved handling of AI-analysis failures and invalid responses so results are more predictable and useful.

inputs.title: Fixed text input editing
inputs.description: The cursor now stays where you place it when editing or deleting text in the middle of comments and other text fields.

photoEditor.title: Photo editor positioning fixed
photoEditor.description: Photos smaller than the editing area are now centered correctly instead of shifting to the side.

errorMessages.title: Clearer error messages
errorMessages.description: Problems with AI analysis, cloud operations, import, and export are now reported more clearly.

1_0_0.summary: The first stable DOne release with the core diary experience.

diary.title: Offline diary
diary.description: Create and edit diary entries on the device with glucose, insulin, carbohydrates, comments, and photos.

aiAnalysis.title: AI meal analysis
aiAnalysis.description: Analyze meal photos with AI and save the result with a diary entry.

subscriptions.title: Diary subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Follow another user's diary with read-only access when permission is granted.

sync.title: Cloud synchronization
sync.description: Synchronize diary entries and photos with the cloud and access cloud diary data.

backup.title: Import and export
backup.description: Export diary data for backup or viewing and restore supported DOne backups.

timer.title: Two-hour timer
timer.description: Start a two-hour timer from a diary entry when you need a reminder after a meal.
